description_en: Creates a Metricstore to store metrics
description_zh: 创建时序库（MetricStore），可用于存储时序数据
kebab_example: aliyun sls create-metric-store --project my-project --name my_metric_store --ttl 7 --shard-count 2 --auto-split true --max-split-shard 64 --biz-mode standard --metric-type prometheus --hot-ttl 60 --infrequent-access-ttl 30 --append-meta false --sharding-policy example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateMetricStore

parameters.help_en: The name of the Metricstore to create
parameters.name: name

parameters.description_en: The data retention period of the Metricstore. Unit: days.
parameters.description_zh: 时序库的数据保存时间，单位为天
parameters.help_en: The data retention period of the Metricstore. Unit: days
parameters.help_zh: 时序库的数据保存时间，单位为天

parameters.description_en:
The period for which data is stored in the hot tier. Unit: days. The value must be at least 7 and cannot be greater than the value of ttl. If you set this parameter to -1, all data is stored in the hot tier for the duration specified by ttl.

When the hot storage period ends, the data is moved to the IA storage class. For more information, see [Tiered Storage of Hot and Cold Data](~~308645~~).
parameters.description_zh:
数据在Logstore热存储层中的存储时间。单位：天，最小为7，最大不能超过ttl的值，取值为-1代表保存时间ttl内全是热存储。

当数据的存储时间超过您所配置的热存储层数据保存时间后，数据将转为低频存储。更多信息，请参见[智能冷热分层存储](~~308645~~)。
parameters.help_en:
The period for which data is stored in the hot tier. Unit: days. The value must be at least 7 and cannot be greater than the value of ttl. If you set this parameter to -1, all data is stored in the hot tier for the duration specified by ttl.

When the hot storage period ends, the data is moved to the IA storage class. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/308645.html
parameters.help_zh:
数据在Logstore热存储层中的存储时间。单位：天，最小为7，最大不能超过ttl的值，取值为-1代表保存时间ttl内全是热存储。

当数据的存储时间超过您所配置的热存储层数据保存时间后，数据将转为低频存储。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/308645.html
parameters.name: hot_ttl

parameters.description_en: The retention period of data in the IA storage class. Unit: days. The minimum value is 30. After this period, data is moved to Archive Storage.
parameters.description_zh: 低频存储。没有最少存储时间要求，至少保存30天转归档存储。
parameters.help_en: The retention period of data in the IA storage class. Unit: days. The minimum value is 30. After this period, data is moved to Archive Storage

parameters.description_en:
Specifies whether to record the public IP address of the client. The default value is false.

- true: Records the public IP address.

- false: Does not record the public IP address.

fields.description_zh: ShardGroup 配置，整个 LogStore 的哈希区间将被均为切分成多个大小相同的 ShardGroup。写入的数据计算一级哈希后选择相应的 ShardGroup 写入。
用于计算哈希的键，大小写敏感，顺序敏感，键不能重复。
